translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose; the drafting system conducted the current full assessment, with a correlated full-text peer pass from the same AI system. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, full source/target comparison and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: Restored the explicit storm image as cơn bão đau buồn đã lắng xuống after full comparison; the earlier working wording conveyed grief but weakened the weather metaphor.
Replaced the stiff cao vợi with a natural expression joining clear perception and elation, without adding spiritual doctrine or moral approval from the narrator.
The selected 1895 her reading is rendered sống thay nàng, preserving another will’s control of her life. It is not silently replaced by the meaning of the 1894 version without her.
Rendered the pleading For heaven’s sake as Trời ơi rather than the stiff standalone Vì Chúa; the urgent spoken register and closed-door scene remain.

The final medical explanation stays attributed to the doctors, with niềm vui chết người left as an ironic phrase; the translation does not state the story’s hidden emotional cause as an objective diagnosis.

selection_limit: The Translation Gap Atlas already records an existing credited Vietnamese translation. This is a new direct, openly reusable and aligned edition, not a claim of first translation, a missing Vietnamese version or a demonstrated quality deficiency.

glossary.source_term: There would be no one to live for her
glossary.draft_rendering: sẽ không còn ai sống thay nàng
alternatives: không còn ai sống hộ nàng
glossary.rationale: Retains the selected1895 her reading and control-of-life meaning; do not substitute the different1894 formulation without her.

glossary.draft_rendering: khát vọng tự quyết đang chiếm lấy nàng
alternatives: ý thức được tự quyết đời mình
glossary.rationale: Make the sudden assertion of her own will readable without claiming that love was wholly absent or introducing a modern political program.
Keep the short ironic medical explanation attributed to the doctors; do not replace it with an explicit explanation of despair or loss of freedom.

alternatives: người chị em ruột / chị Mallard
glossary.rationale: Vietnamese address conventions require choices the English does not settle. Relative age is not established by the source; the selected register is pragmatic and remains a disclosed minor limitation.

witness_decision: The Society’s complete electronic text is the selected witness, including its identified1895 historical readings. The1894 Vogue wording,1895 corrections and modern electronic title are distinguished in provenance. The original print pages were not newly collated; the full extracted public-domain story is preserved as a hashed editorial witness.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Vietnamese uses chị/em for the sisters and bà Mallard followed by nàng for the young married protagonist. English sister does not establish relative age; this is a pragmatic address choice, not new biographical evidence. A more neutral kinship formulation would be less idiomatic.

Khát vọng tự quyết gives Vietnamese readers an intelligible force for possession of self-assertion, but the source’s compressed abstract phrasing has no exact register match. The translation does not add a political program or erase her contradictory love.

title_review.rationale: Chuyện trong một giờ preserves the story’s restricted span and neutral narrative framing. It avoids an interpretive title such as Một giờ tự do, which would supply a thematic conclusion before the reader encounters the ending. The source title is the selected electronic edition’s The Story of an Hour; the historical Dream title is disclosed in provenance.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Compared every sentence of the reported death, Richards’s double telegram, immediate grief, solitary room, seasonal sound/scent/color and suspended gaze; retained rather than medicalized the opening heart condition.

Compared the approaching feeling, failed resistance, repeated freedom, bodily response, future mourning, variant her, imposed wills, occasional love and body/soul refrain. No inference of an unloving or physically abusive husband is inserted.

Compared the closed-door exchange, elixir, opposite prayers about long life, Victory posture, husband’s ignorance of the accident, Richards’s late action and final doctors’ explanation. The ending remains abrupt and unexplicated.
